mapper.select:
WITH FOCUS_PARENT AS ( SELECT COALESCE(F.UPER_NUMB, F.REPL_NUMB) AS REPL_NUMB FROM TB_REPLXX F WHERE F.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND F.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND F.REPL_NUMB = #{focusReplNumb,jdbcType=NUMERIC} LIMIT 1 ), PARENTPAGE AS ( SELECT P.REPL_NUMB FROM TB_REPLXX P WHERE P.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND P.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND P.UPER_NUMB IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN P.REPL_NUMB = (SELECT REPL_NUMB FROM FOCUS_PARENT) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , P.REGI_DATE DESC, P.REPL_NUMB DESC LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit} ), LIKE_COUNT AS ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReply} GROUP BY L.TAGT_NUMB ) SELECT R.TAGT_TYPE, R.TAGT_NUMB, R.REPL_NUMB, R.UPER_NUMB , IF(R.UPER_NUMB IS NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS PARENT_YN, R.USER_NUMB , IF(R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}, #{commYes}, #{commNo}) AS MY_REPLY_YN , R.REPL_CNTN, R.DELT_YSNO, R.REGI_DATE, R.UPDT_DATE , SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|', COALESCE(R.REPL_CNTN, ''), COALESCE(R.DELT_YSNO, '')), 256) AS EDIT_VERSION , IF(R.UPDT_DATE IS NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS UPDT_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UPDT_YSNO', IF(R.UPDT_DATE IS NULL, 'N', 'Y'), NULL) AS UPDT_YSNO_NM , U.USER_NICK, F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , IF(R.DELT_YSNO = #{commYes}, 0, COALESCE(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0)) AS LIKE_CNT , IF(R.DELT_YSNO = #{commYes} OR UL.USER_NUMB IS NULL, #{commNo}, #{commYes}) AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_REPLXX R JOIN PARENTPAGE PAGE ON PAGE.REPL_NUMB = COALESCE(R.UPER_NUMB, R.REPL_NUMB) LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_REPLXX P ON P.TAGT_TYPE = R.TAGT_TYPE AND P.TAGT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB AND P.REPL_NUMB = R.UPER_NUMB LEFT JOIN LIKE_COUNT LC ON LC.TAGT_NUMB = R.REPL_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_LIKEXX UL ON UL.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND UL.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReply} AND UL.TAGT_NUMB = R.REPL_NUMB WHERE R.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND R.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} ORDER BY COALESCE(P.REGI_DATE, R.REGI_DATE) DESC, COALESCE(P.REPL_NUMB, R.REPL_NUMB) DESC , IF(R.UPER_NUMB IS NULL, 0, 1), R.REGI_DATE DESC, R.REPL_NUMB DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_REPLXX (TAGT_TYPE, TAGT_NUMB, UPER_NUMB, USER_NUMB, REPL_CNTN, DELT_YSNO, REGI_DATE, UPDT_DATE) SELECT #{tagtType}, #{tagtNumb}, #{uperNumb,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userNumb}, #{replCntn}, #{deltYsno}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL FROM DUAL WHERE (#{uperNumb,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_REPLXX P WHERE P.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND P.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND P.REPL_NUMB = #{uperNumb} AND P.UPER_NUMB IS NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT R.TAGT_TYPE , R.TAGT_NUMB , R.REPL_NUMB , R.USER_NUMB AS TARGET_USER_NUMB , ACTOR.USER_NICK FROM TB_REPLXX R JOIN TM_USERXM ACTOR ON ACTOR.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND ACTOR.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE R.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND R.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND R.REPL_NUMB = #{replNumb} AND R.DELT_YSNO = #{commNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_LIKEXX (USER_NUMB, TAGT_TYPE, TAGT_NUMB, REGI_DATE) SELECT #{userNumb}, #{likeTargetReply}, #{replNumb}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_REPLXX R WHERE R.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND R.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND R.REPL_NUMB = #{replNumb} AND R.DELT_YSNO = #{commNo})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_LIKEXX WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND TAGT_TYPE = 'REPLY' AND TAGT_NUMB = #{replNumb}
